records.title: Canonical target size correction
records.summary: The canonical research target sha256 e454272ed0fb0247fcbcf300e5d55d7a3e96d50b89b9ffaff81bb978dcbdd082 is 6,356,432 bytes (0x60FDD0). The 3,735,552 value carried by the Phase 12 public migration record is incorrect and is superseded here. The corrected value already matched data/registries/dmc3-reverse-authorities.v1.json, docs/status/canonical-status.json and profiles::dmc3::ResourceTypeContract, so this correction removes a size contradiction between the evidence tree and the rest of the repository. Verified locally against the identified artifact: size 6,356,432; PE32+ x86-64 GUI (machine 0x8664, optional-header magic 0x020B, subsystem 2); ImageBase 0x140000000; entry RVA 0x34615C / VA 0x14034615C. The two ResourceTypeContract evidence windows also reproduce byte-exact at their declared file offsets: registry_content_probe 0x2DA5F0 length 0x72 sha256 4e614cc2d0168d6049a449ed4a1c6a78e0ebdd6b5c4b9699fabd98a63c153d19, family_mask_probe 0x2FCA50 length 0x273 sha256 a31a8c1e225bc62c07dea05921c42eeff85c28b2f4872713594262e579b91961. Only the size field was wrong; every other checked claim in this packet reproduced exactly.
